newsitem.title: USA: Deere to become PGA tour sponsor, supplier.
newsitem.headline: Deere to become PGA tour sponsor, supplier.

text.p: Deere & Co, which manufactures turf maintence and other capital equipment, said on Wednesday it was in a sponsorship agreement with the Professional Golf Association (PGA) Tour to provide golf course equipment and sponsor a PGA golf tournament.

Under terms of the agreement, Deere will sell course and turf maintennace equipment, utility vehicles and selected construction equipment to the tour's owned and operated TPC golf courses as the "Official Golf Equipment Supplier of the PGA Tour," Deere said.
The exclusive deal covers 15 courses initially, with growth of several courses expected each year, a Deere spokesman said.

Deere will also become the title sponsor of the Quad City Classic, which will be renamed the John Deere Classic in 1999, when it moves to a new course designed, constructed and operated by the PGA Tour. The course, called TPC at Deere Run, will be constructed in Rock Island County, Illinois.
Golfer D.A. Weibring will serve as player designer for the course, the company said.
The pact between Deere and PGA Tour runs from 1998 through 2006.
